why: Both sides use the same notions, AdmitsScPartitionsOfUnity (Definition 5.28) and LocalModel.HasApproxProperty (Definition 5.36). The only difference is how 'an atlas' is written. A (theorem_5_5_10, universe 0) uses a set S of charts of the structure (PX.IsChart) covering X. B uses an MAtlas A with A.Equiv PX.atlas. exists_atlas_iff shows the two are the same: charts of the structure are pairwise compatible (IsChart.compatible), so a covering set of them is an atlas equivalent to PX.atlas (MAtlas.equiv_iff), and conversely. Both directions are proved by rewriting with this lemma.
overlap: 187 shared project theorems. All come from the chart-compatibility machinery that MPolyfold.IsChart.compatible pulls in (MChart.compatible_of_locally, Chapter 1-2 sc-calculus and retraction lemmas such as proposition_2_3_1_one and theorem_1_3_1'), plus the auto-generated _proof_ fields of realPolyfold, realChart and IsScSmoothPartitionOfUnity that appear in the statement. No Chapter 5 result (Urysohn functions, hasApproxProperty_restrict, admitsScPartitionsOfUnity_of_approx) is reused.
